{{Quote|The Gorensla have the false information, Gorran and Nell are back under my thumb. Within the clan all will tell of Giarda bringing a traitor down before even Noako could reach him! In all, a very profitable day.|Giarda|<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />}}
'''Giarda''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was one of the leading members of the [[Jiramma]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. Giarda operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and at some stage during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she manipulated the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Gorran]] and [[Nell]] into turning over the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Razall]] to her, who had became an informant for the rival [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]] Hutt clan.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
